atoms.title: Package skeleton and real verifier
atoms.criterion: Swift package targets, mmctl placeholder, synthetic fixture boundary, and fast/full verification are green without importer logic.

atoms.title: Type-7 evidence decision
atoms.criterion: A read-only aggregate analysis records exactly what the eight observed type-7 rows prove and leaves semantics unknown where evidence is insufficient.

atoms.title: Budget period evidence decision
atoms.criterion: A read-only aggregate analysis records evidence and uncertainty for observed PERIOD_TYPE=6 without guessing a vendor label.

atoms.title: Source classifier and immutable reader
atoms.criterion: mmctl classifies supported/unknown/corrupt SQLite profiles read-only and proves before/after source hash equality.

atoms.title: Staging provenance and opaque sidecar
atoms.criterion: Every parsed source record/field receives deterministic provenance and unknown values round-trip through a bounded opaque sidecar.

atoms.title: Loss report and reconciliation
atoms.criterion: Every staged source entity is deterministically mapped, sidecar-preserved, intentionally excluded with reason, or blocking; expect-zero-loss fails otherwise.

atoms.title: Canonical money and temporal primitives
atoms.criterion: Canonical primitives preserve exact amount/currency/raw literal and UTC/local-date/timezone semantics without binary floating point.

atoms.title: Atomic idempotent canonical commit
atoms.criterion: A staged import atomically commits or leaves canonical state unchanged, and repeated identical imports create no duplicate economic event.

atoms.title: Admit the trusted commit gate
atoms.criterion: Human Choice A admits the commit gate by creating the first official Git commit of owned admission records after full verification and both P0 review lenses. A shipped product, L3+ compatibility, and a real-v19 certificate are not claimed. The whole product tree is not included.

atoms.title: Admit bounded baseline atoms
atoms.criterion: Gate v2 permits unrelated untracked paths outside a bounded atom, rejects untracked paths owned by the atom, materializes and fully verifies the exact staged tree, preserves the 400000-byte provider review limit, and preserves mandatory reviewer plus red-team lenses for every P0 atom.
evidence: qualified ./scripts/verify.sh --full: 53 governance tests, 283 Swift tests, mmctl smoke, and production build (2026-08-23)

atoms.title: Freeze architecture stabilization authority
atoms.criterion: Accepted architecture specification, review record, implementation ticket pack, future atom criteria, current-worktree-relative manual runbook, and GATE-002 evidence are mutually consistent and frozen without changing product source, executable gate controls, compatibility claims, or release status.
